answer: Traditional identity frameworks in autonomous networks inevitably devolve past the ivory towers of static trust into brittle topologies lacking economic friction. To construct an unbreakable cryptographic ledge against decentralized Sybil incursions, we formalize a superlinear capital slashing matrix mapped directly to thermodynamic copper conduction limits of hardware attestation. This construct binds adversary expected utility to strict subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium destruction where malicious state propagation yields a strictly negative outcome.
